For a "Notebook" style application, the primary challenge is Long-Context
Management (handling many PDFs) and Structured Data (ensuring features like
Quizzes don't crash). We recommend a Multi-Model Orchestration strategy: using
"Flagship" models for heavy reasoning and "Lite" models for high -frequency studio
tasks.
The Strategy: "Multi -Model Orchestration"
Instead of using one expensive model for everything, we will use a Smart Routing
system.
• Heavy Duty: Use Gemini 1.5/2.5 Pro for the 2 -million-token memory.
• Logic Heavy: Use Claude 3.5 Sonnet for complex structures (Mind
Maps/Reports).
• High Volume: Use GPT-4o Mini or Gemini Flash for fast, cheap tasks
(Quizzes/Slides).
1. Chat Streaming (Document Q&A)
• Options Available: GPT-4o, Claude 4 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5/2.5 Pro.
• Suggested LLM: Gemini 2.5 Pro
• Cost: ~$1.25 per 1M Input tokens (with context caching).
• Efficiency: Native 2-Million token window . Unlike other models that require
complex RAG (searching small chunks of text), Gemini can "read" the entire
notebook at once, ensuring it never misses a detail in a 500 -page document.
• Production Note: Use Context Caching to reduce costs by 90% for repeat
questions on the same documents.
2. Mind Map Generation
• Options Available: Gemini Flash, Claude 3.7/4 Sonnet, GPT -4o.
• Suggested LLM: Claude 3.7/4 Sonnet
• Cost: ~$3.00 per 1M Input / $15.00 per 1M Output.
• Efficiency: Mind maps require spatial logic and strict syntax (like Mermaid.js
code). Mind maps require strict code output (like Mermaid.js). Claude has the
highest "Zero -shot" accuracy for code structure, meaning it won't break the UI.
Claude is currently the market leader in following complex formatting
instructions without "hallucinating" or breaking the code structure.

3. Quizzes & Flashcards
• Options Available: GPT-4o Mini, Gemini Flash -Lite, Llama 4 -Maverick.
• Suggested LLM: GPT-4o Mini
• Cost: Ultra-Low ($0.15 per 1M Input tokens).
• Efficiency: These features burn a lot of tokens because they generate many
small items. These are "high -volume" tasks. Since a user might generate 50
flashcards at once, cost is the priority. GPT-4o Mini is perfect because it's fast,
dirt cheap, and excellent at following JSON schemas for structured testing. GPT-
4o Mini is incredibly fast and highly accurate for simple extraction and
educational formatting.
4. Reports (Long -form Writing)
• Options Available: Claude 4 Opus (High quality), Gemini Flash (High speed).
• Suggested LLM: Claude 3.7/4 Sonnet
• Cost: ~$3.00 per 1M Input.
• Efficiency: Reports need a "human" tone. Gemini can sometimes sound
"robotic." Claude provides the best professional prose, making the reports feel
like they were written by an intern rather than an AI. Claude’s writing style is the
most "human." It avoids the repetitive AI patterns. For a professional -grade
report, the quality justifies the higher cost.
5. Infographics
• Options Available: DALL-E 3, Midjourney API, Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.
• Suggested LLM: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (Nano Banana)
• Cost: Competitive per -image pricing.
• Efficiency: Infographics require the AI to place exact text in specific locations.
This model features "high -fidelity text rendering," which prevents the "gibberish
text" often seen in older AI images. This model supports "Text -in-Image" with high
fidelity. It ensures that the charts and labels in the infographic are actually
readable and spelled correctly.
6. Slide Deck (Outline + Content)
• Options Available: Gemini 1.5 Flash, GPT -4o Mini.
• Suggested LLM: Gemini 1.5/2.5 Flash
• Cost: ~$0.15 - $0.30 per 1M tokens.

• Efficiency: Creating 10 -20 slides requires high "throughput." Gemini Flash has
the best balance of speed and cost. It can process the "source files" and Flash is
optimized for speed and can generate a full deck's content from source
materials in under 2 seconds.
Summary Table for Management
Feature Primary Goal Best Choice Why?
Chat Memory Gemini Pro 2M context; can read entire libraries.
Mind Map Logic Claude Sonnet Strictest adherence to diagram code.
Quiz/Cards Price GPT-4o Mini Cheapest high -quality model available.
Reports Quality Claude Sonnet Best professional writing style.
Slides/Infogr. Speed Gemini Flash Fastest throughput for visual data.
